# Percona XtraBackup 9.7

> Percona XtraBackup 9.7, an open source hot backup utility for MySQL-based servers, with installation, full and incremental backup, restore and reference guides

Each page below is also available as markdown. For the documentation of all Percona products, see https://docs.percona.com/llms.txt.

## Overview

- [Home](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/index.md): Percona XtraBackup is an open source hot backup utility for MySQL-based servers that keep your database fully available during planned maintenance windows.
- [Get help from Percona](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/get-help.md): Our documentation guides are packed with information, but they can’t cover everything you need to know about Percona XtraBackup. They also won’t cover every scenario you might come across. Don’t be…
- [Topic Index](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/index-contents.md)

- [How Percona XtraBackup works](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/how-xtrabackup-works.md): Percona XtraBackup is based on InnoDB’s crash-recovery functionality. It copies your InnoDB data files, which results in data that is internally inconsistent; but then it performs crash recovery on…
- [Differences between a logical backup and Percona XtraBackup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/differences-logical-backup.md): You’ll notice several key differences when transitioning from a logical database backup to Percona XtraBackup. A logical backup contains the database contents as SQL or similar logical data (tables…
- [Backup process overview](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/backup-overview.md): Percona Xtrabackup is a tool that allows you to create backups of MySQL or MariaDB databases. It works by copying the data files and the binary log files of the server, while ensuring that the data…
- [Backup strategy and backup policy](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/backup-strategy.md): In conversation, “backup strategy,” “backup policy,” and “backup plan” are used interchangeably, but the terms have distinct meanings.
- [Backup example](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/example-full-incr.md): This example demonstrates how to set up daily full backups and hourly incremental backups using Percona XtraBackup 9.7 with a MySQL 9.7-compatible database server.
- [XtraBackup backup files](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/generated-files.md): This document provides a guide to the files and directory structure generated by the Xtrabackup tool. This information is essential for system administrators and database professionals who need to…

## Features

- [LRU dump backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/lru-dump-backup.md): Percona XtraBackup includes a saved buffer pool dump into a backup to enable reducing the warm up time. It restores the buffer pool state from ib_buffer_pool file after restart. Percona XtraBackup…
- [Throttling backups](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/throttling-backups.md): xtrabackup does not block database activity during a backup, but xtrabackup generates additional disk input/output (I/O) activity. On systems with limited I/O capacity, this can affect database…
- [Store backup history on the server](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/store-backup-history.md): Percona XtraBackup supports storing the backups history on the server. Storing backup history on the server was implemented to provide users with additional information about backups that are being…
- [Backup size reporting](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/backup-size-reporting.md): Percona XtraBackup reports the size of every successful backup in xtrabackup_info and reports the same values in the XtraBackup error log.
- [Take a streaming backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/take-streaming-backup.md): Percona XtraBackup supports streaming mode. Streaming mode sends a backup to STDOUT in the xbstream format instead of copying the files to the backup directory.
- [Accelerate backup process](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/accelerate-backup-process.md): When making a local or streaming backup with xbstream binary, multiple files can be copied at the same time when using the --parallel option.
- [InnoDB B-tree integrity validation during prepare](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/innodb-btree-check.md): The --check-tables option validates the structural integrity of InnoDB B-tree indexes during the --prepare phase.
- [Point-in-time recovery](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/point-in-time-recovery.md): Recovering up to particular moment in database’s history can be done with xtrabackup and the binary logs of the server.
- [FLUSH TABLES WITH READ LOCK option](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/flush-tables-with-read-lock.md): The FLUSH TABLES WITH READ LOCK option does the following with a global read lock:
- [Improved log statements](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/log-enhancements.md): Percona XtraBackup is an open-source command-line utility. Command-line tools have limited interaction with the background operations and the logs provide the progress of an operation or more…
- [InnoDB Redo Log Archiving](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/redo-log-archiving.md): A physical backup includes raw copies of database contents and related files, such as configuration files and logs. During crash recovery, InnoDB uses the redo log to correct data from incomplete…
- [Reduced backup lock time](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/reduction-in-locks.md): The --lock-ddl=REDUCED option reduces the time the server remains locked by xtrabackup during full and incremental backups. This allows you to perform Data Definition Language (DDL) operations while…
- [Smart memory estimation](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/smart-memory-estimation.md): Percona XtraBackup supports the Smart memory estimation feature. With this feature, Percona XtraBackup computes the memory required for prepare phase, while copying redo log entries during the backup…
- [Work with binary logs](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/working-with-binary-logs.md): The xtrabackup binary integrates with the log_status table. This integration enables xtrabackup to print out the backup’s corresponding binary log position, so that you can use this binary log…
- [FIFO data sink](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/xbcloud-binary-fifo-datasink.md): Percona XtraBackup implements a data sink that uses the first in, first out (FIFO) method. With the FIFO data sink feature, users with a streaming capacity of 10Gbps (typically on a Local Area…
- [Exponential backoff](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/xbcloud-exbackoff.md): Exponential backoff increases the chances for the completion of a backup or a restore operation. For example, a chunk upload or download may fail if you have an unstable network connection or other…

## How to

- [Prepare a full backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/prepare-full-backup.md): Percona XtraBackup 9.7.2-2 renames the --apply-log-only option to --apply-redo-only.
- [Create an incremental backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/create-incremental-backup.md): xtrabackup supports incremental backups, which means that they can copy only all the data that has changed since the last backup.
- [Prepare an incremental backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/prepare-incremental-backup.md): Preparing an incremental backup combines a full backup with one or more incremental backups to create a consistent backup that you can restore.
- [Take an incremental backup using page tracking](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/page-tracking.md): To create an incremental backup with page tracking, Percona XtraBackup uses the MySQL mysqlbackup component. This component provides a list of pages modified since the last backup, and Percona…

To make a compressed backup, use the --compress option along with the --backup and --target-dir options. A local or streaming backup can be compressed…

- [Create a partial backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/create-partial-backup.md): xtrabackup supports taking partial backups when the innodb_file_per_table option is enabled.
- [Prepare a partial backup](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/prepare-partial-backup.md): The procedure is analogous to restoring individual tables: apply the logs and use the --export option:

## Troubleshoot

- [xtrabackup exit codes](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/xtrabackup-exit-codes.md): The xtrabackup binary exits with the traditional success value of 0 after a backup when no error occurs. Any non-zero exit value means that an error occurred.
- [Dependency compatibility and limitations](https://docs.percona.com/percona-xtrabackup/9.7/update-curl-utility.md): xbcloud depends on several system libraries for correct operation. Some versions of these dependencies are known to cause unexpected terminations or unstable behavior and are therefore not supported.
